what: Monte Carlo sweep of the simulator (deterministic agent policy, no model), paired with FIFO and a blind fee on the same jobs

findings.safety: 0 of 3464 jobs moved back by a purchase ended late, in 300 seasons
findings.throughput: the market delivered 1.19% more jobs on time than FIFO (95% CI 1.07% to 1.31%); ahead in 228 seasons, level in 64, behind in 8
findings.fairness: jobs FIFO delivers that the rule makes late: market 682 (1.73% of jobs, none of them moved by a purchase), blind fee 3901 (9.92%)
